0022600192.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, 1st in the Northwest and 3rd in the West) enter this 10th game of their season on a three-game winning streak, with a 4-0 home record, while the Washington Wizards (4-5, 8th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 1.5 games back) have lost two straight. Oklahoma City won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 132-111 in Washington on March 21, 2026, and the teams have not played yet in 2026-27. Thunder players out are Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Jaylin Williams (back spasms) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. For Washington, Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve) are out, and Anthony Davis (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
